BLE_TRANSPORT_LOST: The connection to the device was lost. Please return to the previous screen and reconnect.
TIMEOUT_OR_UNKNOWN: No response was received from the device. Please wait a moment and try again.
API_ERROR: Failed to communicate with the server. Please check your internet connection.
NOT_WIFI: This QR code is not for Wi-Fi setup. Please scan a valid QR code.
UNSUPPORTED_FORMAT: This QR code format is not supported. Please enter the network information manually.
INVALID_CONTENT: Failed to read the QR code. Please enter the network information manually.
ERR_TOKEN: Authentication failed. Please sign out and sign in again.
ERR_MAC: Failed to retrieve device information. Please restart the device and try again.
ERR_SAVE: Failed to save the settings. Please restart the device and try again.
ERR_FATAL: Failed to connect to Wi-Fi. Please check your input and network environment, then try again.
ERR_PARAMS: There is an issue with the input. Please check your entries.
NO_SSID: The specified Wi-Fi network could not be found. Please check the SSID and try again.
WRONG_SECURITY: Failed to connect to Wi-Fi. Please check your input and try again.
WRONG_PASSWORD: The password is incorrect. Please enter the correct password and try again.
ERR_DHCP: Network connection failed. Please check your Wi-Fi router settings and connection status.
GENERIC_ERROR: An error occurred. If the issue persists, please provide the following code.
